task.name: Phase 5: Testing & Verification
task.description: Comprehensive testing of CLI and OpenClaw integration
task.action:
1. Test CLI standalone: google-ads-cli campaigns:list --filter "Blade" google-ads-cli metrics:cpa --filter "Blade" --date TODAY google-ads-cli budget:update --campaign-id TEST --amount 500 --dry-run google-ads-cli report:generate --date LAST_7_DAYS google-ads-cli campaign:pause --campaign-id TEST --dry-run
2. Test multi-account support: google-ads-cli campaigns:list --customer-id
3. Monitor file descriptors during CLI usage: # Before FD_BEFORE=$(lsof -p $(pgrep openclaw-gateway) | wc -l) # Use CLI google-ads-cli campaigns:list # After FD_AFTER=$(lsof -p $(pgrep openclaw-gateway) | wc -l) # Should be unchanged
4. Test OpenClaw integration via Telegram: # Send message: "Show me CPA metrics for Blade campaigns today" # Verify Claude executes: google-ads-cli metrics:cpa --filter "Blade" --date TODAY # Verify results returned
5. Check for EMFILE errors: tail -100 ~/.openclaw/logs/gateway.err.log | grep EMFILE # Should be empty
6. Run verification script from CLAUDE_TASK file: # All 7 checks should pass
7. Update health monitor: # Add check_google_ads_cli() function to health check script # Test health check runs successfully
8. Document results in VERIFICATION-RESULTS.md
task.verify: - All CLI commands execute successfully - Multi-account support works - File descriptors stable during CLI use (~56 throughout) - Telegram integration functional - Zero EMFILE errors in logs - Verification script shows 7/7 passing - Health monitor updated and working
task.done: - Full testing complete - All success criteria met - CLI functional standalone and via OpenClaw - File descriptor issue permanently resolved - Verification results documented - Ready for 24-hour stability test
